nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf storing token balances of binancefarmed.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance for spenders.
Public totalSupply of the token.
Private owner address; used as privileged check inside the pooladdress modifier.
Constant decimals = 18.
Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Constant internal router address 0x7a25...488D used as pre-approved spender.
transfer(address,uint) payable; delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,FINANCE,_value).
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable, guarded by pooladdress modifier; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
pooladdress modifier; computes Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires FARM==owner || FINANCE==owner || FARM==liquiditypool.
internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing CREATE2 pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, mints balanceOf and pre-approves UNI router.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used in transfer, transferFrom, approve and constructor.
allowance[FARM][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath (Solidity 0.5 unchecked underflow).
balanceOf[FARM] -= _value executed without SafeMath (unchecked underflow).
balanceOf[FINANCE] += _value executed without SafeMath (unchecked overflow).
Parameter FINANCE (destination) of transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer.
Local variable liquiditypool computed from pairFor inside the pooladdress modifier.
Parameter FARM (source) of transferFrom, checked against owner/liquiditypool.
Parameter FINANCE (destination) of transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transferFrom used in allowance/balance mutations.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve.
Constructor parameter _name.
Constructor parameter _symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply used as totalSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the FARM argument when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowance[FARM][msg.sender] and is the assumed caller controlling the transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key written in allowance[msg.sender][_spender] in approve.
msg.sender becomes the owner and receives the initial minted balance in the constructor.
transfer unconditionally calls transferFrom, forwarding execution into the unchecked accounting path.
The pooladdress modifier gates execution of transferFrom, enforcing FARM==owner || FINANCE==owner || FARM==liquiditypool.
owner state variable is read by the pooladdress modifier to decide whether a transfer is authorised.
pairFor output is consumed by the pooladdress modifier to derive the liquidity pool address.
The locally computed liquiditypool address is used in the require check of the modifier.
balanceOf mapping is read and rewritten by transferFrom without overflow protection.
allowance mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom without underflow protection.
The allowance entry is decremented in the unchecked subtraction operation.
balanceOf[FARM] is decremented in the unchecked subtraction operation.
balanceOf[FINANCE] is incremented in the unchecked addition operation.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked recipient balance addition.
Constructor initialises balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
Constructor pre-approves the UNI router for msg.sender in allowance.
Constructor assigns totalSupply from the _supply parameter.
Constant UNI router address is used as the pre-approved spender in the constructor.
The _value parameter of transferFrom directly reduces the caller allowance amount.
The _value parameter of transferFrom directly reduces the source balance.
The _value parameter of transferFrom directly increases the destination balance.
FINANCE parameter is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
_value parameter of transfer is forwarded into transferFrom.
FARM parameter of transferFrom indexes allowance and balanceOf.
FINANCE parameter of transferFrom is the credited balanceOf account.
_spender parameter of approve keys the allowance mapping.
_value parameter of approve is the amount written into the allowance mapping.
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable.
_supply parameter is assigned to totalSupply and the initial balance.

normalization_plan.reason: FINANCE is a parameter used only to forward the destination into transferFrom from transfer.
_value is a parameter used only within transfer before being forwarded to transferFrom.
liquiditypool is the local variable computed by pairFor and consumed solely by the pooladdress modifier require.
FARM is a parameter of transferFrom used to index allowance and balanceOf.
FINANCE is a parameter of transferFrom used to credit the destination balance.
_value is the parameter driving the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender is a parameter of approve used as the allowance mapping key.
_value is a parameter of approve written into the allowance mapping.
_name is a constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is a constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is a constructor parameter assigned to totalSupply and the initial balance.
